title: Luxor Technology Raises $16M to Scale AI Compute Infrastructure
summary:
A strategic investment round led by CMT Digital has provided Luxor Technology with funding to expand its capabilities in the artificial intelligence compute market. The $16 million raise saw participation from several angel investors and industry partners, including Canaan, MicroBT, Halo and Steelhead.

The bitcoin mining and infrastructure firm will utilize the capital to leverage its eight years of experience in energy and risk management to support AI compute customers. CMT Digital stated that the investment is intended to help the company's clients navigate the hardware and power requirements of the growing AI sector.
